articles.title: CVE-2026-39997
articles.summary:
A missing authentication for critical function vulnerability has been reported to affect HybridDesk Station. If exploited, the vulnerability could allow remote attackers to gain access to the system.

We have already fixed the vulnerability in the following version:
HybridDesk Station 4.2.22 and later

articles.title: CVE-2026-39991
articles.summary:
A cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability has been reported to affect Notes Station 3. If a remote attacker gains a user account, they can then exploit the vulnerability to inject malicious code.

We have already fixed the vulnerability in the following version:
Notes Station 3 3.9.12 and later

articles.title: CVE-2026-39989
articles.summary:
A server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability has been reported to affect Download Station. If a remote attacker gains a user account, they can then exploit the vulnerability to read application data.

We have already fixed the vulnerability in the following version:
Download Station 5.10.1.312 and later
Download Station 5.11.2.321 and later

articles.title: CVE-2026-34015 — CVSS 6.5
articles.summary:
A path traversal vulnerability has been reported to affect Video Station. If a remote attacker gains a user account, they can then exploit the vulnerability to read the contents of unexpected files or system data.

We have already fixed the vulnerability in the following version:
Video Station 5.8.8 and later

articles.title: CVE-2026-34014
articles.summary:
An incorrect permission assignment for critical resource vulnerability has been reported to affect Download Station. If a local attacker gains an administrator account, they can then exploit the vulnerability to compromise the security of the system.

We have already fixed the vulnerability in the following version:
Download Station 5.10.1.312 and later
Download Station 5.11.2.321 and later

articles.title: CVE-2026-34008
articles.summary:

articles.title: CVE-2026-34006
articles.summary:

We have already fixed the vulnerability in the following version:
sMedio DTCP MOVE 1.4.5 and later

articles.title: CVE-2026-26245 — CVSS 8.8

We have already fixed the vulnerability in the following version:
Video Station 5.8.8 and later

articles.title: CVE-2026-26243
articles.summary:

We have already fixed the vulnerability in the following version:

Qsync Central 5.1.0.2 and later

articles.title: CVE-2026-63314
articles.summary:
WebCTI service for Slican IPx telephone exchanges is vulnerable to SQL Injection in /webcti/admin_json.php enpoint. Improper neutralization of input allows an authenticated attacker to execute SQL Injection attacks.


This issue was fixed in IPx series version 6.62.0100.

articles.title: CVE-2026-35088
articles.summary:
Slican telephone exchanges use symmetric encryption for TCP/IP communication. Secret key is hardcoded in multiple binary files. An attacker who has access to these files can decrypt the communication.

This issue was fixed in IPx series version 6.62.0100.

The issue STILL EXISTS in End-Of-Life telephone exchanges:
- CCT-1668 (CCT1CPU)
- MAC-6400
- CXS-0424
These products were discontinued in 2011

articles.title: CVE-2023-32198 — CVSS 8.0
articles.summary: A vulnerability has been identified in Steve where by default it was using an insecure option that did not validate the certificate presented by the remote server while performing a TLS connection. This could allow the execution of a man-in-the-middle (MitM) attack against services using Steve.

articles.title: CVE-2026-101310 — CVSS 7.0
articles.summary:
The HDA audio device model did not check for zero-length Buffer Descriptor List (BDL) entries when starting a stream.  A zero-length entry caused an out-of-bounds read or write during DMA transfer processing.  BDL fields were also subject to modification by the guest after validation.

A malicious guest can crash the bhyve process or potentially execute arbitrary code in the host userspace context

The size was re-read from guest memory on each use, and Transfer Request Block (TRB) fields were loaded without protection against concurrent modification by the guest.  This race condition could be triggered by a guest running malicious, privileged code.
